description: Adds 'kovan setup [--dry-run] [--force]' to kovan-cli: hard-coded curated tool list (crates/kovan-cli/src/commands/setup.rs), PATH detection via the 'which' crate, cargo-install spawn with per-tool error handling, Android no-op gate on the actual install. Unit + e2e tests added. README documents the install flow. Investigated adding 'grit' (GritQL) for git integration per user follow-up request: NOT added — GritQL's official CLI (getgrit/gritql, docs.grit.io) is not published on crates.io under grit/gritql/marzano/marzano-cli; its docs list only npm (@getgrit/cli) and a curl-fetched prebuilt-binary installer, no cargo install path. Status: done, built/tested/clippy-clean on host and aarch64-linux-android.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: gitoxide added to TOOLS per user follow-up: crate_name=gitoxide (binary crate), binary_name=gix (default-run; also installs ein). Confirmed via cargo search/cargo info + v0.55.0 Cargo.toml [[bin]] targets. Now 6 tools. Chosen over grit (no cargo path).

title: kovan setup: install curated external CLI tools (eza/rg/fd/bat/tokei) via cargo install

description: Flow-path network momentum solve across the control-volume graph, with valves, pumps, critical flow, CCFL, bubble rise and junction phase separation. Reuse the existing HEM choked-flow capability in tampines-steam-tables (genuinely validated against Moody and Zaloudek -- but NOT Marviken, see that bead) and the IEC 60534 valve sizing / pump modes already real in outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs. The network solve itself is greenfield -- nothing exists.
title: melcor-fl: junction momentum network over the CV graph, valves, pumps, CCFL
